content.equation:
Dose in mg:
Dose in mg = 50 * Weight
• Weight is input in kg
• When capsules, tablets, or chewable tablets are chosen as the dosage form, the
dose in mg is rounded based on combination available with selected formulation
dosage strengths
Dose in mL:
Dose in mL = (50 * Weight) / Concentration
• Weight is input in kg
• Concentration is input in mg/mL
notes: Tablet, capsule, and chewable tablet answers are rounded to the closest dosage based on available dosage forms; oral solution answers are rounded to the nearest whole number (mg), 0.5 mL, and 0.1 tsp.

content.instructions: To perform a calculation, enter the required variables. Once all the inputs are entered, click the "Calculate" button to perform the calculation. Any time an input variable is adjusted, the "Calculate" button must be clicked to populate the new output. To start over, click the "Reset" button to clear all values and begin the calculation again. This calculation is intended to provide an infective endocarditis prophylaxis dose for pediatric patients >3 months of age and <40 kg. Children ≥40 kg should typically follow adult dosing.
